items.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
items.summary: Unsurprisingly, following the scandal involving now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, Congress is looking to further restrict exports of AI chips.
